description: Use this tool whenever a user asks about federal or state estate taxes, the 2026 $15,000,000 Single / $30,000,000 Married OBBBA estate tax exemption, whether to gift appreciated stock/real estate during life (IRC Sec. 1015 carryover basis) vs. holding in a Revocable Living Trust until death for the IRC Sec. 1014 step-up in basis, Irrevocable Grantor Trusts / SLATs under IRS Revenue Ruling 2023-2 and Sec. 675(4)(C) swap powers, or state estate tax cliffs (NY, MA, WA, OR, IL, MD, MN, CT).

appreciatedAssetValue.description: Current market value of appreciated taxable assets (stocks, ETFs, real estate) in USD.

assetCostBasis.description: Original cost basis of the appreciated assets in USD.

filing.description: 'mfj' for Married Couple (with DSUE Portability) or 'single' for Single/Widowed.

heirStateRate.description: Heirs' state capital gains tax rate percentage (defaults to selected stateCode rate).

totalEstateNow.description: Total current net worth / gross estate in USD.

useSwapPower.description: True if grantor exercises IRC Sec. 675(4)(C) cash substitution power before death on Path C SLAT.

name: analyze_estate_tax_and_stepup
title: Analyze Estate Tax, Revocable Trust Step-Up in Basis (IRC Sec. 1014) vs. Lifetime Gifting (Sec. 1015)
